xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5474: docs: dashboard views and the Experimental setting

plan.title: docs: dashboard views and the Experimental setting
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-5532 UI text/filter bugs found in planning

narratives.Problem: introduction.mdx still lists '13 views' including removed views (Mission Control, Convoys, Handoffs), and no docs page explains the current dashboard views, the Simple/Advanced Home, the left nav and More menu, or which views the Experimental features switch reveals.
narratives.Proposal: Add one page, features/dashboard-views.mdx, built section by section from verified code facts in the PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-5474.md): Find a view, Home, Board, Pipeline, Awaiting Merge, issue drawer and full issue view, Activity, Knowledge, Context, Skills, Settings, Experimental features, Get help. Add it to docs.json after features/mission-control, replace or link from the stale introduction table (checkpoint against PR #5528), add one cross-link line to five related pages, and record clean Mintlify checks in the PR body.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No changes under src/, scripts/, tests/, packages/ or apps/; no changelog.d entry
- No fixes to the UI bugs filed as #5532 (Experimental description, Cycle filter, No PR chip, Merging label, palette reaching hidden views, dead drag code)
- No rewrite of docs/KANBAN-MODEL.md (#2344) or docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md
- No new or refreshed screenshots, and no use of the June images/dashboard/* set
- No in-depth Flywheel, Order books, Backlog, Costs, command palette or issue pipeline docs (sibling issues own them)
- No documentation of the other three Experimental toggles or of individual Settings sections
- No edits to introduction.mdx beyond decision D-5
- Never run mint validate --fix

autoDecisions.summary: Use only the issue-cockpit screenshot; skip the June images/dashboard set
autoDecisions.rationale: The June PNGs show the old Panopticon v0.21.0 brand and pre-PAN-5293 sidebar; the issue forbids inventing UI and allows only existing real screenshots, and issue-cockpit was captured 2026-11-14 and matches current tabs.

autoDecisions.summary: Code wins over the Experimental toggle's own description
autoDecisions.rationale: EXPERIMENTAL_TAB_IDS omits activity and skills while the Settings text names them; the issue requires claims to match code. The page says once that Activity and Skills stay available, and the text bug is filed as #5532.

autoDecisions.summary: Describe buggy controls by label only (Cycle options, No PR chip, pending merge label)
autoDecisions.rationale: Their behavior does not match their labels; documenting either would be wrong after the #5532 fix. Labels are stable facts.

autoDecisions.summary: introduction.mdx edit uses a grep checkpoint against PR #5528
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5505's open PR already deletes the 13 views table; the work agent replaces it only if it still exists after sync-main, otherwise adds one link sentence, avoiding a conflicting rewrite.
Command Deck is the main-view page; dashboard views is its natural neighbor, and inserting avoids reordering pages sibling issues own.

autoDecisions.summary: Filed #5532 and commented on #2344 instead of widening scope
autoDecisions.rationale: The research found UI bugs and dev-doc drift outside a docs-only issue; recording them keeps them tracked without expanding this PR.

metadata.sizeJustification: Docs-only change: one new page plus its docs.json nav entry, a one-sentence link in introduction.mdx, and one-line cross-links in five existing pages. The 8 'subsystems' are 8 Mintlify doc directories/files, not code subsystems; each cross-link is meaningless without the page, and the page is not findable without the nav entry and links, so splitting into sibling issues would ship broken or orphaned docs. Items touching the page are serialized by blocks edges.
